region.description: Australia's premier family holiday destination — golden beaches, world-class theme parks, lush hinterland, and family-friendly everything.

areas.name: Surfers Paradise
areas.description: Iconic beach, buzzing nightlife, family attractions, shopping — the heart of the Gold Coast.

areas.name: Broadbeach
areas.description: Dining hub, Pacific Fair shopping, Kurrawa Beach, quieter than Surfers but still central.

areas.name: Main Beach / The Spit
areas.description: Marina Mirage, Sea World, calmer beaches, more relaxed vibe.

areas.name: Coolangatta
areas.description: Southern Gold Coast, twin towns with Tweed Heads, beautiful beaches, surf culture.

areas.name: Burleigh Heads
areas.description: National park headland, surf breaks, village shopping, very family-friendly beach.

areas.name: Southport / Labrador
areas.description: Broadwater parklands, Australia Fair shopping, Chinatown, family picnic spots.

areas.name: Robina / Mermaid Beach
areas.description: Robina Town Centre shopping, Cbus Super Stadium, Pacific Fair nearby.

areas.name: Gold Coast Hinterland
areas.description: Tamborine Mountain, Springbrook, glow worm caves, rainforest walks, wineries.

driving.parkingNote: Many accommodations include free parking. Street parking in central Surfers can be paid ($4-8/hr). Theme parks include free parking.

airportTransfer.familyShuttle: Approx. $80-$120 family return from Coolangatta Airport to Surfers Paradise.
airportTransfer.rideShare: Approx. $55-$85 from Coolangatta Airport to Surfers Paradise.

meta.priceAccuracyNote: All prices and costs are estimates generated on 2026-07-12. Availability and final pricing must be confirmed with each provider. The Gold Coast Holiday Builder does not sell tickets, take bookings, or hold money.
